## 简体中文

### 新增

- 新增 Windows 11 风格的快速最小化与恢复过渡动画，点击仅有一个窗口且已聚焦的任务栏应用时生效。
- 新增设置项，可在 macOS 屏幕共享或远程管理会话期间自动关闭自定义最小化动画。

### 性能

- 远程连接期间跳过快照捕获和过渡渲染，直接隐藏或恢复应用，以保持远程操作流畅。

## English

### Added

- Added a fast Windows 11-style minimize and restore transition when clicking a focused single-window app on the taskbar.
- Added a setting that automatically disables the custom minimize transition during active macOS Screen Sharing or Remote Management sessions.

### Performance

- Skipped snapshot capture and transition rendering while remotely connected, hiding and restoring the app immediately to keep remote interaction responsive.
